title: Accommodation Supplement: eligibility (Social Security Act 2018 ss 65-67, Social Security Regulations 2018 reg 15), OpenFisca Aotearoa encoding, week 2022-W01

attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 16; openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/social_security/accommodation_supplement/entitled.py:28; resident.py:21 (defined term with its own formula, set directly as input, see CONVERSION.md 3 and C2)

attributes.source: Social Security Regulations 2018 reg 15(1)(a); openfisca_aotearoa/variables/regulation/social_security_regulation/accommodation_supplement/assets.py:21; relationships.py:8 (defined term with its own formula, set directly as input, see CONVERSION.md 3 and C2)

attributes.source: Social Security Regulations 2018 reg 15(1)(a)(ii), (b); openfisca_aotearoa/variables/regulation/social_security_regulation/accommodation_supplement/assets.py:24 (>= 1); interpretation/child.py:43 (count, set directly as input, see CONVERSION.md 3 and C2)

attributes.name: accommodation_supplement__cash_assets
attributes.source: Social Security Regulations 2018 reg 15(1); openfisca_aotearoa/variables/regulation/social_security_regulation/accommodation_supplement/assets.py:49-63 (total cash assets of principal and partners <= threshold); parameters/social_security/accommodation_supplement/assets.yaml: ssa2018_15_1_a = 16200 and ssa2018_15_1_b = 8100, both from 2018-11-26 (only values); the attribute is the total of the applicant and partner (CONVERSION.md 4)

attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 67(a); openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/social_security/accommodation_supplement/exclusion.py:46-49 (family sum over role partner of accommodation_supplement__receiving, :82, default False); value of the partner's variable (CONVERSION.md 4)

attributes.name: basic_grant__entitled
attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 67(b)(ii); openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/social_security/accommodation_supplement/exclusion.py:56-59 (read at period.first_month); openfisca_aotearoa/variables/regulation/student_allowance/basic_grant.py:10 (Student Allowances Regulations 1998 reg 4; own formula, set directly as input, see CONVERSION.md 3 and C2)

attributes.name: independent_circumstances_grant__entitled
attributes.source: SSA 2018 s 67(b)(ii); openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/social_security/accommodation_supplement/exclusion.py:56-59 (read at period.first_month); openfisca_aotearoa/variables/regulation/student_allowance/independent_circumstances.py:8 (input variable, no formula)

output.name: accommodation_supplement__entitled
output.source: openfisca_aotearoa/variables/acts/social_security/accommodation_supplement/entitled.py:10-73, value at week 2022-W01 of the family's principal

exclusions.description: The applicant is not in a relationship but a partner receives Accommodation Supplement. The partner exists only as a member in the family role partner, and the encoding's own definition makes such a member a relationship (people.family.nb_persons(PARTNER) > 0).
exclusions.source: SSA 2018 s 67(a) ('P's spouse or partner'); relationships.py:20-24

exclusions.description: The applicant is eligible for an independent circumstances grant while receiving a basic grant. Student Allowances Regulations 1998 reg 8(3): 'no student is eligible for an independent circumstances grant if the student receives a basic grant'.
exclusions.source: Student Allowances Regulations 1998 reg 8(3), quoted in openfisca_aotearoa/variables/regulation/student_allowance/independent_circumstances.py:24-25

period.why: The week asserted by the only SSA 2018 entitlement case (2018/entitled.yaml). formula_2018_11_26 applies from 2018-11-26 and assets.yaml has one value per threshold, so every week from then on gives the same table.

household.value: the applicant is principal of a family, of a tenancy and of an ownership with no other member; when social_security__in_a_relationship is True the family also has one partner, with cash assets 0 and accommodation_supplement__receiving from the attribute partner_accommodation_supplement__receiving
household.why: s 65(2)(a), (b) and (d) distinguish principal tenants or owners from other tenants or owners (costs.py:24-87); with the applicant as sole principal, (d) coincides with (a) and (b). See CONVERSION.md 4.

accommodation_supplement__receiving (app.why: Read for every person but summed over the partner role only (exclusion.py:41-49); the applicant's own value has no effect.

notes: Eligibility of the family's principal for Accommodation Supplement under the SSA 2018 formula. The SSA 1964 formula of the same variable (applies to weeks before 2018-11-26, tested by 1964/entitled.yaml) is kept as a supplementary table outside paperC/specs (paperC/openfisca_nz/supplementary/NZ-AS-1964/). See CONVERSION.md.
